name: chopstr
description: chopstr: Clipping-Tool für den DACH-Raum. Sinntreu geschnitten, jede Auswahl erklärt, EU-verarbeitet.

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/web --if-present && npm run test:worker
scripts.test:worker: cd workers && (uv run pytest -q || python3 -m pytest -q)
scripts.residency:check: cd workers && (uv run pytest -q tests/test_residency.py || python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_residency.py)
